observations.value: Upright abdominal radiograph: multiple small-bowel air–fluid levels.
observations.name: Abdominal radiograph

observations.value: CT: multiple small-bowel air–fluid levels and a linear hyperdense intraluminal structure consistent with a foreign body; mechanical obstruction suspected.
observations.name: Abdominal CT

observations.value: Emergency laparoscopy converted to open operation because of purulent fluid and adhesions. A Meckel diverticulum ~40 cm proximal to ileocecal valve contained a biliary stent; its distal end perforated adjacent ileum.
observations.name: Diagnostic laparoscopy / Exploratory laparotomy

observations.value: About 20 cm of small bowel, including diverticulum and perforation, was resected with side-to-side anastomosis, irrigation and drainage.
observations.name: Operative resection

availability_policy: Each observation requires a requested examination/test/procedure. Non-time_zero gates must additionally be satisfied; retrospective results are never available for immediate care. No unreported results may be invented.
